summary: High Roller Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Mutual Collaboration Agreement with Foris DAX Markets, Inc. (Crypto.com) and affiliates, serving as a guaranteed introducing broker for event-based derivative contracts (Predictions Contracts) on Crypto.com's trading system. The agreement has a two-year initial term with auto-renewal; CDNA is the exclusive provider for the first 24 months. High Roller must develop a mobile app for customer trading. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation. This is a routine commercial agreement, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There are no deal terms or risk-arb elements to monitor.
